title: We are Changing our Developer Productivity Experiment Design
attributed_claim_summary: METR reported that selection effects and simultaneous-agent time measurement undermined confidence in its newer productivity comparisons.
evidence_or_event: Source-authored report or launch; no original measurements collected in this repository.
limitations: Author-reported methodological limitation; revised design is not itself a universal causal estimate.
research_relevance: AI-era coding workflow -> secure functionality -> independent reuse -> lifetime cost; distinguish release availability from observed adoption.
practical_experiment: Record all randomized tasks including abandonments; capture multi-agent human time, concurrent elapsed time and uncertainty.
